name: Shenzhen Expressway Corporation Limited
summary: Shenzhen Expressway Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, primarily invests in, constructs, operates, and manages toll highways and roads, as well as other urban and transportation infrastructure in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Toll Road, Environmental Protection, and Others segments.
